shots.focal_element: Single centred all-caps caption word over black-and-white live-action footage
shots.typography: Geometric sans, bold, ALL CAPS, slightly tight tracking, large centred single word; font guess (low confidence): Plus Jakarta Sans or similar geometric grotesk
shots.what_happens: A sub-0.3 s flash shot: the mid-shot keyframe shows 'PEOPLE' (semi-transparent grey) over a shallow-focus monitor showing a ClickUp task view beside a plant, while the 24.5 s sheet frame shows 'TIME' in white over a cheering office crowd with confetti cannons and neon line art. Captions track the VO word by word ('people' w70, 'time' w71). The two images disagree, so there are probably micro-cuts inside this shot id that the detector did not split.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut a ~0.3 s B&W footage clip on the beat and overlay the current VO word as a centred bold uppercase caption timed to that word's start.

shots.focal_element: Celebrating crowd firing confetti cannons, with a word-by-word caption building above them
shots.typography: Geometric sans, bold, lowercase, normal tracking, medium size; words added one at a time on a slightly uneven baseline (the last word sits lower)
shots.what_happens: B&W footage of a crowd cheering and firing confetti cannons beneath a neon loop shape. A lowercase caption builds word by word in sync with the VO ('from switching between', w72-w74), first 'from' alone at left-centre, then the full phrase centred. Anchors log 3 motion events.
shots.build_rebuild: Over B&W celebration footage, append each VO word to a centred lowercase caption at its word start time, popping each new word in with a short scale/opacity tween.

shots.focal_element: Two-tier caption (lowercase lead-in over large uppercase keyword) on B&W people footage
shots.typography: Two-tier hierarchy: small bold lowercase lead-in ('a bunch of') stacked above a much larger bold ALL CAPS keyword ('DIFFERENT'); geometric sans, centred
shots.what_happens: Another ~0.34 s flash shot. The mid-shot keyframe shows 'a bunch' over a woman on a night rooftop next to a studio monitor speaker; the 26.0 s sheet frame shows 'a bunch of' / 'DIFFERENT' over a woman in profile giving a thumbs-up backstage. The caption keeps building across the cut (w75-w78). The two images show different footage, so there is probably an undetected micro-cut.
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the caption layer persistent across rapid footage cuts and promote the key word to a second, larger uppercase line when it is spoken.

shots.focal_element: Smiling man in a patterned shirt on stage behind a three-line stacked caption
shots.typography: Stacked three-line lockup: small bold lowercase lead-in, then two large bold ALL CAPS lines of equal size, tight leading, centred geometric sans
shots.what_happens: B&W stage footage of a man laughing in front of neon line art. The caption finishes as a stacked lockup 'a bunch of / DIFFERENT / APPLICATIONS' when 'applications' is spoken (w79) and holds for the rest of the shot. Anchors log 1 event (the APPLICATIONS line arriving).
shots.build_rebuild: Add the final keyword as a third uppercase line under the second, aligned and the same size, then hold the completed three-line lockup centred over the footage until the cut.

shots.focal_element: Held 'DIFFERENT APPLICATIONS' caption lockup over behind-the-scenes camera-crew footage
shots.typography: Same stacked lockup as s017 (lowercase lead-in over two bold uppercase lines); the presenter frame shows a bold lowercase single-word subtitle low-left
shots.what_happens: A ~0.29 s shot. The mid-shot keyframe shows the held 'a bunch of / DIFFERENT / APPLICATIONS' lockup over shallow-focus B&W footage of camera operators with a cinema rig. The 27.5 s sheet frame instead shows the presenter in colour against black with the lowercase subtitle 'but' (w80). This is probably a micro-cut from the B-roll into the presenter that falls inside this shot id. I cannot confirm the exact order.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold the completed caption over one last behind-the-scenes clip, then hard cut to the colour presenter on the next VO word.

shots.focal_element: Presenter in a patterned shirt, centred against black, with a giant gradient 'BUNDLING' word layered behind his head
shots.typography: Lower-third subtitles in bold lowercase geometric sans, built word by word with an uneven per-word baseline. The emphasis word 'BUNDLING' is huge, heavy, ALL CAPS with a horizontal gradient fill and soft glow, spans the frame width and sits behind the presenter (his head hides part of it). Supporting words ('a bunch of', 'tools together') are placed bottom-left and bottom-right, flanking him.
shots.what_happens: Colour talking-head of the presenter against a black void. Word-by-word subtitles follow the VO ('but we knew the answer wasn't just', w81-w86). On 'bundling' (w87) a giant glowing gradient 'BUNDLING' appears behind his head, the subtitle above it fades out, and 'a bunch of' and 'tools together' (w88-w92) build in the lower corners. The last sheet frame (31.0 s) already shows a new colour office scene, a man at an iMac with the caption 'We', so the cut into s020 may fall just before the logged shot end.
shots.build_rebuild: Key the presenter out from a black background and put a full-width gradient-filled uppercase keyword with an outer glow on a layer between the background and the presenter, so his head occludes it. Fade it in on the keyword's word start while the side words build in the lower-left and lower-right corners.
